top_signals.title: Inside the Auctions for Singapore's Seized Luxury Goods
top_signals.summary: Three years after a S$3 billion money laundering scandal hit Singapore, some seized luxury items like designer bags have been snapped up at auction. But upscale condos are struggling to find buyers. Srinidhi Ragavendran explains why. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs log $2.7 billion in September inflows as institutional demand holds
top_signals.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $2.65 billion in net inflows in September, their second-largest monthly inflow since October 2025.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Nordic Business Alliance Weighs Expanding Into Critical Minerals
top_signals.summary: Nordic Compass, a competitiveness-focused business alliance, is considering branching out into critical raw materials to build up the region’s capacity to process minerals needed by European industry.
